title: Cardiovascular Risk Reduction in Diabetes
implementation_guidance: Implement a comprehensive cardiovascular risk reduction protocol for patients with diabetes that includes: 1) Systematic assessment of ASCVD risk using validated risk calculators; 2) Evidence-based statin selection and dosing based on risk category; 3) Blood pressure management targeting individualized goals based on comorbidities; 4) Appropriate use of antiplatelet therapy based on risk-benefit assessment; 5) Lifestyle modification counseling including smoking cessation, physical activity, and dietary approaches; and 6) Regular monitoring of lipid panels, blood pressure, and medication adherence. Document all interventions and clinical outcomes including changes in lipid parameters, blood pressure, and achievement of individualized goals.
expected_outcomes: Reduced cardiovascular events, improved lipid profiles, better blood pressure control, increased use of evidence-based cardioprotective medications, and enhanced patient understanding of cardiovascular risk factors.
target_population: All patients with diabetes, with emphasis on those with established ASCVD or multiple risk factors
citation: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes—2024. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Supplement 1):S158-S174. doi:10.2337/dc24-S010
